english.title: Driver / passenger carry out repairs to / refuel a motor vehicle in Blackwell / Silvertown Tunnel areas
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[the driver of]_
(B)_[a passenger in]_

a motor vehicle that had broken down,

(C)_[carried out repairs to]_
(D)_[refuelled]_

a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE..) in the

(E)_[Blackwall]_
(F)_[Silvertown]_

tunnel area, without the permission of an authorised person
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaw 7(11) of the Blackwall and Silvertown Tunnels Byelaws 2018 and article 48(6) of the Silvertown Tunnel Order 2018.
